tenders.scope_en: Multi-disciplinary and professional expertise, skills and capacity support for the council's Energy Island Programme. The notice states the work is consultancy support for activity relating to a new nuclear development at Wylfa; detailed requirements sit in the tender documents.

tenders.title: 체코 원자력안전청(SÚJB) — 원자력안전 영향 기기 건전성·수명평가 전문·기술지원 기본협약
tenders.title_en: Czech nuclear regulator SUJB — framework for expert and technical support on integrity and lifetime assessment of equipment affecting nuclear safety
tenders.scope: 규제기관의 검사·평가 업무를 뒷받침하는 전문·기술지원. 체코 원전 기계 기기와 그 부품의 강도·수명 평가 분야에서 원자력법(263/2016 Sb.) 및 시행령 329/2017·358/2016·162/2017·408/2016 Sb. 요건 충족 여부에 대한 독립 평가 수행. 기본협약, 접수 2027-01-07 09:00.
tenders.scope_en: Expert and technical support to the regulator's own inspection and assessment work: independent assessment of compliance with the Atomic Act (263/2016 Sb.) and decrees 329/2017, 358/2016, 162/2017 and 408/2016 Sb. in evaluating the strength and service life of mechanical components at Czech nuclear plants. Framework agreement, submissions due 7 January 2027 09:00.

tenders.buyer: Societatea Nationala NUCLEARELECTRICA S.A. — Sucursala CNE Cernavoda
tenders.title: 루마니아 누클레아렐렉트리카 — 체르나보다 전동기 공급 (CR 47144)
tenders.title_en: Nuclearelectrica (Romania) — supply of an electric motor for Cernavoda (CR 47144)
tenders.scope: 기술시방서 CR 47144(정오표 포함)에 따른 전동기 공급. 단품 기자재 조달. 접수 2026-12-07 15:00.
tenders.scope_en: Supply of an electric motor in accordance with technical specification CR 47144 and its erratum. Single-component equipment procurement, submissions due 7 December 2026 15:00.

tenders.title: 이탈리아 SOGIN — 해체 부지 방사선방호 계측기 'Full Risk' 정비용역 사전시장조사 3건 (825452·825357·825454-2026)
tenders.title_en: SOGIN (Italy) — three further preliminary market consultations for 'Full Risk' maintenance of radiation protection instrumentation
tenders.scope: 해체 부지 방사선방호 계측기의 'Full Risk' 정비용역 조달 준비를 위한 사전시장조사(공공계약법 제77조). 공고 기재 총액 각 7,668,983 / 4,368,200 / 1,030,136 유로. 11-23·11-24·11-27 제조사별 분할 공표 시리즈의 연속.
tenders.scope_en: Preliminary market consultations under Article 77 of the public contracts code, preparing procurement of 'Full Risk' maintenance for radiation protection instrumentation at decommissioning sites. Stated totals EUR 7,668,983 / 4,368,200 / 1,030,136. A continuation of the manufacturer-by-manufacturer series published on 23, 24 and 27 November.
